narrative: Material PL1__M98CE2FE exhibits smooth, gamma-like daily demand averaging 349.6 units with a CV of 0.51 and no detectable trend over the observation period. Lead times are moderately variable (CV=0.63, mean=1.55 days), with occasional spikes to 5 days driving the safety stock requirement. A continuous-review (r,Q) policy with EOQ batch sizing minimises total inventory cost while maintaining 95% service level, yielding a 46% annual cost reduction versus the current SAP baseline. The storage capacity constraint is non-binding at the recommended order quantity.

research_insights.selected_model: (r,Q) Continuous Review Reorder Point with EOQ
research_insights.selection_rationale: Smooth demand pattern with >95% non-zero days and moderate lead-time variability is well-matched to a continuous-review policy. EOQ minimises the sum of ordering and holding costs; the reorder point absorbs stochastic lead-time demand at 95% service level using the normal approximation.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity (5,023.86 units) caps maximum post-replenishment stock at safety_stock + order_quantity = 3,238 units, leaving 1,786 units of headroom. If mean demand grows >35% or safety stock increases, the capacity constraint will bind and require either a warehouse expansion or reduced order quantities with more frequent replenishments.
